description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the TimezonesAPI endpoint within the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin. It contains test methods to verify the 'getAll' functionality and check that delete/create operations are not implemented. The class extends a base test case for API endpoint integration testing.

classes.name: TimezonesAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the TimezonesAPI endpoints, focusing on retrieving all timezones and verifying non-implemented delete/create operations.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' method of the TimezonesAPI, including fixture setup and mocking services.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for 'testGetAll', including a special handling for PHP version >= 7.4.29 to modify timezone data.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the delete operation is not implemented in the API.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rule for delete is not implemented in the API.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the create operation is not implemented in the API.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rule for create is not implemented in the API.
